title: I Rank the 7 Best Stocks to Buy Right Now October 2026
creator: Joseph Hogue, CFA
summary: Joseph Hogue's weekly update (published 4 Oct) argues market concentration is the whole story: the nine largest S&P 500 stocks added 13.5% while the index itself is only up 13% YTD, meaning the other 491 stocks contributed nothing. The common thread is AI — 'the only game in town' at this point in the bull market — but this late in the cycle you must be picky. He walks through five AI segments and names seven stocks he is buying now: ServiceNow and Palantir in software (agentic orchestration theme, cheap PEGs), Nvidia and Broadcom in infrastructure (0.48x PEG and best data-center exposure), Zscaler and Fortinet in cybersecurity (cheapest PEGs in an expensive group), and Bloom Energy in power (0.44x PEG, colocated generation). He owns and is holding Palo Alto and CrowdStrike but calls them too expensive to add; Oracle is the one name he says to 'definitely avoid' over the neo-cloud crack-up. Nebius and CoreWeave soften to waits. He also warns of an 'October surprise': September oil near $100 will push the 14 Oct CPI up, likely triggering a typical 3-5% dip — don't be all-in, hold cash to buy the dip. Auto-captions garble names heavily (Panw/PAW, Fortnite/FTNT, Zcaler/ZS, Oristrista/ANET, Verdive/VRT); figures treated as approximate.
